populationDefinition: All Page-level post records currently recoverable from the KC Spaces Fund public Facebook Page's 2020 timeline in Jamie's authenticated view. Nested shared-story cards are not denominator records.

publicTimeline.denominatorMethod: Select outer Page records whose profile identity begins with KC Spaces Fund, including location-qualified Page posts; exclude nested shared-story cards; reconcile date plus photo fbid where available, otherwise date plus expanded outer message or attachment class.

currentProfileDisplay.meaning: Mutable profile displays at capture, not historical reach or community size.

namedGranteeOrDisbursementAnnouncements.meaning: Public announcement count, not a complete grant ledger or proof of every underlying payment event.

currentVisibleReactionSnapshot.meaning: Mutable platform displays at capture, not unique people, reach, donor conversion, endorsement, causality, or impact.

stakeholderResponseSample.meaning: One bounded current public response sample, not campaign-wide endorsement, partnership, reach, or impact.

postedUrlInventory.meaning: Research and action routes; a posted URL is not proof of source truth, readership, endorsement, clicks, donation conversion, partnership, or outcomes.

nonPosterRoleMemory.statement: Jamie states that he was not the stakeholder or owner posting through the KC Spaces Fund Facebook account.

roleControls.namingSupportMemory: Jamie recalls supporting selection of a name available consistently across social platforms and domain names.
roleControls.meaning: Implementation records support Jamie's behind-the-scenes digital role. Naming support remains an attributed memory. Neither establishes public organizing, Page-post authorship, fundraising ownership, grant decisions, or sole naming authority.

limitations: This is 100% of the currently recoverable Page-level July 2026 surface, not an official Meta export of all posts ever created.
Deleted, unpublished, pre-migration-omitted, and otherwise unavailable records remain outside the observable population.
Page identity does not establish the human author or publisher of an individual post.
The record-level corpus, private engagement relationships, authentication state, and management controls remain outside the public repository.
